ARCHIVE.description: Inspect actual eligibility/consumer inventory and recover every selected original from unchanged archives; compare decoded bytes/size/SHA256, locator links/commands and preserved historical manifests. No filename-only or closed-issue inference.

CAPACITY.description: Measure final complete RI hash inventory and tracked bytes separately; report actual savings/headroom under unchanged250MB cap and bounded pending R12 costs. Unknown later outputs remain pending.

PUBLIC.description: Verify exact unchanged site/docs/runtime/rights/retained/test inputs against accepted base; PR110 and ongoing R12 excluded. No public or rollback closure loss.

PROCESS.description: Independently review canonical mandatory post-production archival workflow, ownership, exact-source trigger, active/unfinished exceptions, recovery and normal reviewed maintenance route; no host deletion or new pipeline.

REVIEW.description: Four actual distinct source-bound roles, final/correction reviews, test impact and applicable CS01/04/05/08/09/10. Trusted complete-diff lane/Basic/RI/owning checks and native Draft PR observation are separate; no merge/production authority inferred.
